text:
caroline (Midwest Retail): Hey team — SSO started failing for a large subset of users after our IdP rotated certs at ~02:00 UTC. Users get a 403 and the app logs show 'SAML signature invalid' and 'Assertion recipient mismatch'. Need help, this is blocking login for ops.

anna (Support): Sorry about that — we're on it. Can you paste the IdP metadata URL and a short SAMLResponse (truncated) or SAML tracer output? Also which workspace and app env is this for?

caroline (Midwest Retail): metadata URL: https://idp.midwest.example/metadata.xml
workspace: midwest-prod
Sample SAMLResponse (redacted):
```xml
<samlp:Response>
  <saml:Assertion>
    <saml:Subject>
      <saml:SubjectConfirmation>
        <saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient='https://app.midwest.example/sso/acs/' NotOnOrAfter='2024-09-08T02:05:00Z'/>
      </saml:SubjectConfirmation>
    </saml:Subject>
    <ds:Signature>...signature blob...</ds:Signature>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```
Error we see in browser SAML tracer: Signature validation failed. We noticed ACS has trailing slash. IdP rotated signing cert at 02:00 UTC, they confirmed via support ticket.

raj (Oncall SRE): Thanks. On our side the SP is configured for ACS = https://app.midwest.example/sso/acs (no trailing slash). That explains the recipient mismatch. Our SAML validation is strict on Recipient equality by default. Two likely culprits: 1) IdP is still sending old metadata or 2) IdP config uses ACS with trailing slash. Can you confirm the entityID in the metadata?

caroline (Midwest Retail): entityID in metadata is https://idp.midwest.example/shib
IdP team says they pushed new metadata but left an ACS alias with trailing slash for backward compatibility. They assumed SPs would accept both.

raj (Oncall SRE): Repro steps for us:
1) fetch metadata curl -I https://idp.midwest.example/metadata.xml
2) inspect KeyDescriptor entries to ensure new cert present
3) simulate validation with our metadata cache disabled.
Example fetch and inspect:
```
curl -s https://idp.midwest.example/metadata.xml | xmllint --format - | sed -n '1,120p'
```
Look for blocks like:
```xml
<KeyDescriptor use='signing'>
  <KeyInfo>
    <X509Data>
      <X509Certificate>MIIF...newcert...</X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
<KeyDescriptor use='encryption'>
  ...older cert...
</KeyDescriptor>
```
If the signing cert is present, then the problem is ACS/recipient mismatch. If not present, our cached metadata might be stale.

anna (Support): Two immediate options:
- Quick but risky: enable lenient ACS matching for the workspace so both https://app.midwest.example/sso/acs and https://app.midwest.example/sso/acs/ are accepted. Path: Console > Workspace > Auth > SAML > Advanced > Lenient ACS Match. API:
```
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"lenient_acs_match":true}' https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/workspaces/midwest-prod/saml
```
- Recommended: ask IdP to update the ACS entry to exactly match our configured ACS (no trailing slash) or update their outbound SAML to use the exact SP ACS value.

nicole (Security): We prefer the IdP to update config. Enabling lenient match temporarily is ok for a short window for recovery but track and revert. Since certs rotated, confirm the new signing cert fingerprint and verify assertion signature after any change.

caroline (Midwest Retail): IdP agreed to change ACS to match SP exactly. They estimated a 1 hour ETA.

raj (Oncall SRE): I'm also seeing our metadata-refresh job did not pick up the new signing cert immediately — there was a 20m lag because their metadata max-age was large. We can force refresh from our side if you want a faster path. To force refresh (internal API):
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/internal/saml/refresh?entity=https://idp.midwest.example/shib
```
I'll trigger that now and then check the signature validation using a test assertion.

deploy-bot: metadata-refresh job started for entity https://idp.midwest.example/shib

deploy-bot: metadata-refresh job completed for entity https://idp.midwest.example/shib; new signing cert found (fingerprint=AB:CD:12:34), cache updated.

raj (Oncall SRE): After forced refresh I validated a sample assertion; signature verifies with new cert but the recipient mismatch still breaks because of trailing slash. IdP said they'll push ACS exact match in 30-60m. If you need immediate access and accept the risk, we can enable lenient_acs_match temporarily.

caroline (Midwest Retail): Please enable lenient match for 30 minutes so ops can log in while IdP patches. We'll monitor and confirm.

anna (Support): Done — lenient_acs_match enabled for midwest-prod. Please test and report back. We'll plan to auto-disable in 45m.

caroline (Midwest Retail): Confirmed logins working now for 90% of users. We'll validate more and let you know. Thanks team.

nicole (Security): Reminder: once IdP confirms, request reversion and rotate any certs if needed.

raj (Oncall SRE): Marking this as in-progress; will close when IdP confirms and lenient mode is turned off. ETA 2h.

deploy-bot: lenient_acs_match flag will auto-revert in 45 minutes per policy.

anna (Support): Closing thread for now, reopen if regressions seen. Thanks everyone.
